coverage: Field notebook offline registration queue with real Web Crypto and injected storage/network: older notebooks open with an empty queue; teams come from the last online workspace; every local refusal (name, age, sex, locality, team, referral without visit, blood pressure pair, numbers, future time, facility, reason) with nothing queued or sent; sealed storage without names in the notebook; lock/unlock survival; Sync all in dependency order (registrations, then visit drafts, then media) with a lost registration response stopping the run and retried with the same key and body; possible matches fetched and shown on the device, not resent until reviewed, then resent with the review under a new key; refusal routed to review and resent only on request with a new key and the same registration id; a new-key resend after an unseen success returning the same person; temporary failure and a 2xx without a person kept pending with the same key; overflow and candidate-free conflicts routed to review; bodies valid for the server schema; discard, removal and the 10-item limit; another account refused. Real IndexedDB and browser offline behaviour are not tested here.
